name: Allbridge CCTP phantom deposit
summary: CCTPTokenMessenger accepted a generic Circle attestation, decoded a token amount from its attacker-authored body, and credited a deposit without verifying that Circle minted USDC.
notes: setRemoteTokenMessenger(5, 0xdac2959b638247ab586f6c3ffcfc9c352d3aae5c) completed the Polygon receive-path configuration after domain 7 had been mapped to Allbridge chain ID 5. The receive function required this exact value as sourceSender, and the attacker copied it into the forged generic Circle message. The getter retained this value immediately before exploitation; later configuration calls addressed other chain IDs.

At block 50157344 the Router held 191,155.976393 USDC; 191,112.338841 USDC had been legitimately minted into it three blocks earlier and the remaining baseline was 43.637552 USDC. The attacker flash-borrowed and deposited 808,844.023607 USDC, then redeemed a phantom 1,000,000 USDC credit for a 999,000 USDC payout. The Router ended with its 1,000 USDC fee, so exact pre-existing victim depletion was 190,155.976393 USDC. The 404.422012 USDC flash-loan premium reduces attacker proceeds, not gross victim loss.
